title: 变化与数量词汇
goal: 辨认变化方向、程度及数量与比例表达。

points.label: 区分数量、比例与范围表达

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 变化词表明数量的方向、速度或幅度。例如 rise 表示上升，decline 表示下降。
数量是实际多少，比例是部分占总体的份额。例如 20 students 是人数，20% of students 是比例。
gradual 表示逐渐发生，abrupt 表示突然发生。例如 a gradual rise 与 an abrupt rise 的变化速度不同。

items.stem: A count rises slowly over five years. Which phrase describes it?
items.why: rises slowly 表示逐渐上升，即 gradual increase。

items.stem: A price drops suddenly. Which phrase describes it?
items.why: drops suddenly 表示突然下降，即 abrupt fall。

items.stem: A report states that 30 of 100 households use a service. Which expression gives a proportion?
items.why: 30% 表示使用服务的家庭占总体的比例。

items.stem: Daily counts go from 12 to 18. Which expression gives the range?
items.why: from 12 to 18 表示数值范围。

groups.text: A centre counted visitors over four months. The monthly totals were 100, 120, 140 and 140. In the final month, 70 visitors used the reading room. The rest used other services.

items.stem: How did the total change between the third and fourth months?
items.why: 第三和第四个月均为 140，数量保持不变。

items.stem: What proportion used the reading room in the final month?
items.why: 最后一个月共 140 人，70 人使用阅览室，占一半，即第二项。第四项把 70 当成了 100 人中的份额。

groups.fill: Residents tracked daily water use. Their rec{ords} showed a gra{dual} decline i{n} the amo{unt} used. T{he} number o{f} households rema{ined} stable, wh{ile} the ave{rage} amount fe{ll} over several months. The residents compared figures from the same months in different years. They also noted changes in the number of people living in each home. The group used the figures to discuss possible reasons for the decline, while recognizing that the records alone could not establish a cause. They planned to continue recording water use.

items.stem: A value moves up and down repeatedly. Which verb describes it?
After a sudden rise, a figure stops changing. What has it done?
items.why: 上升后停止变化是 levelled off。

items.stem: A total goes from 200 to 180 in one day. Which description fits?
items.why: 总数在一天内下降，对应 abrupt decrease。

items.stem: Which expression gives the actual count rather than a proportion?
items.why: twenty users 给出实际人数。

items.stem: A group has 40 members, and 10 attend a meeting. What fraction attends?
items.why: 40 人中有 10 人出席，占四分之一，即第一项。

items.stem: Measurements extend from 5 to 9 units. Which phrase reports their range?
items.why: from 5 to 9 units 给出数值范围。
